title: enform user.deprovisioned@1 event payload
description: The payload of a user.deprovisioned@1 event (#267, ID-5, I4, I14). The directory no longer holds the principal: the event names the account and the tasks the deprovision returned to the pool, each of which is its own task.released@1 event with the reason. The actor is the person with org.grants who deprovisioned the account, or system:directory when the directory synchronization did.

principal.description: The immutable id of the deprovisioned user (ID-4).

released.description: The tasks the user held and the deprovision released (A1, WF-5), in the order of the release events.

step.description: The step whose task was released (WF-1).
